System Map

Read together, the four themes are not separate pressures. Four loops connect them. Each gap filled alone (R1): states that fill US gaps separately fragment European capability. Scale draws more users (R2): adoption of the largest cloud and AI providers widens their lead. Speed crowds out checking (B1): faster AI advice leaves less time to question it. Secrecy deters researchers (B2): security duties that come with defence money can push researchers away. Arrows that cross a colour are connections no single theme carries.

LoopNameWhat it doesThis cycle
R1Each gap filled alone
Filling the US gap		Gaps left by US forces lead each state to buy separately, separate purchases fragment European capability, and fragmented capability leaves gaps of its own.Priming: states buy separately
R2Scale draws more users
Cloud and AI suppliers		Adoption by armed forces raises the largest providers’ share, their share funds a capability lead, and the lead draws more adoption.Turning: AWS cleared NATO-wide
B1Speed crowds out checking
AI in planning		More AI advice leaves less time and habit for checking it, less checking lets errors pass, and errors found later bring caution.Priming: users doubled; no pause yet
B2Secrecy deters researchers
Research		More defence research money brings more security duties, stricter duties deter some researchers, and fewer researchers taking part limit what the money buys.Priming: money arrives first

Hover over a status for its meaning: Priming means the parts are in place but the circle has not yet closed at scale. Turning means every step in the loop has current evidence, so it is running now.

The Scenario Matrix’s horizontal axis asks whether loop R1 (each gap filled alone) runs or is broken by joint purchases; its vertical axis asks whether loop R2 (scale draws more users) keeps running, or European alternatives built with research money slow it.

What it means: the link that ties the four themes together is that separate national purchases pull smaller states toward American cloud and AI, and American AI brings advice that staff must be trained to question. The levers an organisation controls are which gaps it fills with neighbours, how its staff are trained to challenge AI, whether it has exit plans, and the terms on which it works with universities.
